confounds.window_only: the window changes and nothing else: locked depth, width, frequencies, rate and global tau normalization

hypothesis.name: window
hypothesis.prediction: a shorter window improves the fit: each shorter prefix arm's E is below the lap10 control's on all three registered cases
hypothesis.statement: the full [0, 10] window is harder than the orbit's early motion; a shorter exact signed-lap prefix fits better at the locked settings

metadata_algorithm.baselines: same_window_expectations (67-03) per window: the window-mean constant and the two-Kepler comparison, independently cross-checked
metadata_algorithm.frequency: N_in from the committed Phase 59 panels row; f = N_in/10 cycles per physical time unit on both backbones
metadata_algorithm.harmonic_phase_increment: max adjacent 2*pi*k*f*dt per harmonic k; strictly below pi or EXP-04 timing refuses without retuning
metadata_algorithm.normalizer: the retained Phase 59 recorded normalizer; never refit

no_continuation: no branch extends, retries or re-sizes any run after its score is read; an unsettled endpoint is recorded as unsettled
positive_control_note: Phase 66 (EXP-01) remains a multi-setting positive control (D-02): its confirmed Tier-1 fit refutes only 'too small' and identifies no single enabling setting

lap1.flat: no effect against the control inside the registered rule; the hypothesis is not supported on this arm
lap1.hypothesis: under the hypothesis, shorter window improves the fit: this arm's E is below the control's on all three registered cases under the registered effect rule
lap1.mechanical: this arm's evidence is mechanically unusable; it reads nothing about the hypothesis
lap1.opposite: this arm fits worse than the control; the hypothesis is contradicted on this arm
lap1.unsettled: the endpoint is still improving when its budget ends; the no-continuation policy records it and extends nothing

reading_rule.confirmation: all three registered cases qualifying in one direction with settled, clean endpoints

descriptive.adjacent_time_similarity: adjacent-time hidden-state similarity is associated evidence only; no cosine threshold and no causal claim
descriptive.gap_59_08: GAP-59-08: E is the frozen scorecard's position-error score; no energy bar or scorer definition is adjudicated here

reading_rule.effect: a case qualifies through a matching tier change or a relative E effect of at least twenty percent
reading_rule.improvement: (E_at_3N/4 - E_at_N)/E_at_3N/4 strictly greater than five percent leaves the endpoint unsettled

science.optimizer_steps: the phase67_budget common N, frozen at budget time before any science run

ambiguous.reason: the ambiguous branch is registered and equally recorded; no continuation runs (the no-continuation policy) and no scope change is proposed

confirmed-improvement.reason: the hypothesis-supported branch is a registered technical ruling; continue under D-01

confirmed-worsening.reason: a refuted lead: the registered hypothesis is contradicted on all three cases, so a concrete owner proposal under SCOPE-49 is recorded before dependent work continues

inconclusive-mechanical.reason: an out-of-rule result routes to the owner under SCOPE-47; dependent work waits for the ruling

unsettled.reason: the unsettled branch is registered and equally recorded; no continuation runs (the no-continuation policy) and no scope change is proposed
